function: p. 7: PPO sets per-MU precoder power and rate weights, from which a classical weighted sum-rate solver derives precoder and RIS phases/amplitudes, jointly with computing-speed and task-offloading decisions.
system: p. 3, 9: uplink, 5 cells each with a 4-antenna BS, 5 two-antenna MUs and a 32-element reflecting RIS; 2.4 GHz carrier and 1 MHz bandwidth (Table II).
method: p. 7-9: PPO reinforcement learning (five 128-neuron layers) with Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty reward and space aggregation, single-agent and multi-agent versions, trained in simulation.
data_channel: p. 4, 9: simulated cells with random RIS and MU positions; the channel model, path loss and fading are never stated; no dataset or measurement.
test_conditions: p. 10-13: policies trained to convergence and evaluated per setting while varying MUs, FC nodes, RIS elements, arrival rate, Lyapunov weight and CSI correlation; no train-test mismatch.
baselines: p. 9-10: Greedy-SimA, JPCRPS [26] alternating optimization, DMUDDPG [21], LSADQN, LPPO without aggregation, plus Rand-RIS and No-RIS references.
metrics: p. 10-13: total Lyapunov cost C, queue length, energy consumption, and training time to convergence.
complexity: p. 8-9: training complexity O(NI Q^2 K^2 NB) for LSAPPO and O(NI Q K^2 NB) for multi-agent LSAPPO; training time measured (Fig. 5, p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "The MUs demonstrate quasi-static characteristics, while the perfect CSI varies with the time slot t." The paper never names a channel model (no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data); Table II (p. 9) lists only frequency, bandwidth and noise.
q2_support: p. 10: "Training is terminated upon the convergence of the RL reward" for each configuration; the sweeps over MUs, FC nodes, RIS elements, arrival rate and CSI correlation (pp. 10-13) are separate runs, and no model trained in one setting is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 9: "Greedy-SimA: This method involves a greedy optimization technique applied in each time slot" and p. 10: "JPCRPS [26]" alternating optimization are non-learned; p. 10: "DMUDDPG [21]: A decentralized deep RL approach uses DDPG for multi-user" is learned; p. 12: "LSAPPO outperforms the LSADQN algorithm, which employs a deep Q-network" on cost C.
q4_support: p. 8: "the time complexity is expressed as O(NI Nstate Naction NB )" giving O(NI Q2 K 2 NB ) for LSAPPO; p. 9: "which is expressed as O(QNI Nstate Naction NB )" for the multi-agent version.
q5_support: p. 9: "Our simulation system model consists of 5 cells" trained and tested on a simulator; no link, DOI or repository for code or data appears anywhere, and no public channel dataset is used.
notes: Borderline, included under the joint-learning clause of above_phy: the policy outputs an aggregated wireless action (rate weights and per-MU power) with the computing and offloading actions (p. 7). But p. 7 says "it seems redundant to directly determine these parameters through RL": the precoder direction and RIS amplitudes/phases come from a classical weighted sum-rate solver P3. A reviewer who reads the learning as acting only above the physical layer would exclude it as above_phy. Table II (p. 9) is an image; frequency and bandwidth were read from the page image.
